# Lalima Photo Studio (ललिमा फोटो स्टुडियो)

> Family-run photo studio in Gauradaha, Jhapa, Koshi Province, Nepal. Run personally by Shantiram Dhungana (Abeer) and his wife for almost 30 years, since the film era.

- Phone / WhatsApp / Viber: +9779842649065
- Email: contact@lalimastudio.com
- Hours: Sunday to Friday, 8:00 AM to 8:00 PM (Nepal time). Closed Saturday.
- Location: Gauradaha, Jhapa, Nepal. Map: https://maps.app.goo.gl/wXTnyADQiChKzfYM7
- Languages: Nepali, English
- Pricing: on request, quoted per job.

## Services
- [Wedding Photography & Videography](https://lalimastudio.com/services/wedding-photography-videography.html): Every ritual, every smile, captured beautifully: photos, films and albums you'll treasure.
- [Studio Portraits](https://lalimastudio.com/services/studio-portraits.html): Family, baby and individual portraits with professional lighting.
- [Event Photography](https://lalimastudio.com/services/event-photography.html): Bratabandha, pasni, birthdays and community events, covered with care.
- [Passport & ID Photos](https://lalimastudio.com/services/passport-id-photos.html): Correct sizes for passport, citizenship, licence and visa, ready while you wait.
- [Photo Printing & Framing](https://lalimastudio.com/services/photo-printing-framing.html): Sharp prints, enlargements, frames and lamination.
- [Flex Board Printing & Design](https://lalimastudio.com/services/flex-board-printing-design.html): Eye-catching shop boards, banners and posters, designed and printed for you.
- [Vehicle Number Plate Printing](https://lalimastudio.com/services/vehicle-number-plate-printing.html): Clear, durable number plates for bikes, cars and commercial vehicles.
- [Photo Restoration](https://lalimastudio.com/services/photo-restoration.html): Bring old, faded or torn family photos back to life.

## FAQ
- How do I book a wedding? Send us your date on WhatsApp or call. We'll confirm availability and plan with you.
- How long do wedding photos and videos take? We'll give you a clear delivery date when you book, based on the package you choose.
- Can I get passport photos the same day? Yes, usually within minutes.
- Do you design flex boards or only print them? Both. Bring your idea and we'll design it.
- Do you print vehicle number plates? Yes. Ask us what documents to bring.
- Do you travel outside Gauradaha? Tell us your venue when you enquire and we'll let you know.
